{{nihongo|'''Omiya Shrine'''|大宮神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

It is identified with '''Ajiko Shrine''' (あじこじんじゃ), a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}<ref name="geo">[https://izuoshima-geo.org/know/highlights/culturalsite/bunkasite-12.html 大宮神社] - 伊豆大島ジオパーク</ref>.

=== Overview ===
Its founding is unknown. It was originally enshrined in the Ajiko settlement in the southern mountains, but to avoid repeated volcanic ashfall from eruptions it was moved to the current site in the Muromachi period ({{ill|1466|Q6559|qid=Q6559}}), and at that time {{ill|Amaterasu|abstract|Q455602|ar|أماتيراسو|ary|أماطيراسو|az|Amaterasu|bcl|Amaterasu|be|Аматэрасу|be_x_old|Аматэрасу|bew|Amatérasu|bg|Аматерасу|ca|Amaterasu|cs|Amaterasu|da|Amaterasu|de|Amaterasu|el|Αματεράσου|eo|Amaterasu|es|Amaterasu|et|Amaterasu|eu|Amaterasu|fa|آماتراسو|fi|Amaterasu|fr|Amaterasu|gl|Amaterasu|he|אמטראסו|hi|अमातेरसु|hr|Amaterasu|hu|Amateraszu Ómikami|hy|Ամատերասու Օմիկամի|id|Amaterasu|it|Amaterasu|ja|天照大神|jv|Amaterasu|ka|ამატერასუ|ko|아마테라스 오미카미|la|Amaterasu|lb|Amaterasu|lt|Amaterasu|lv|Amaterasu|min|Amaterasu|ml|അമതേരസു|mni|ꯑꯃꯇꯦꯔꯁꯨ ꯑꯣꯃꯤꯀꯃꯤ|ms|Amaterasu|nl|Amaterasu|nn|Amaterasu|no|Amaterasu|or|ଆମାତେରାଶୁ|pa|ਆਮਾਤੇਰਸ|pl|Amaterasu|pt|Amaterasu|ro|Amaterasu|rsk|Аматерасу|ru|Аматэрасу|sco|Amaterasu|sh|Amaterasu|simple|Amaterasu Ōmikami|sk|Amaterasu Ómikami|sl|Amaterasu|sr|Аматерасу|su|Amaterasu|sv|Amaterasu|ta|அமதெரசு|th|อามาเตราซุ|tl|Amaterasu|tok|jan sewi suli Amatelasu|tr|Amaterasu|uk|Аматерасу|uz|Amaterasu|vi|Amaterasu|wuu|天照大神|zh|天照大神|zh_min_nan|Amaterasu|zh_yue|天照大神|qid=Q455602|lt=Amaterasu-ōmikami}} was additionally enshrined<ref name="geo"/><ref name="navi">[https://oshima-navi.com/shrine/shrine003.html 大宮神社] - 伊豆大島ナビ</ref>.

=== Cultural properties ===

* Evergreen {{ill|Japanese ship Shii|Q11540757|qid=Q11540757}} grove of Nomashi Ōmiya - Tokyo-designated natural monument<ref name="geo"/><ref name="navi"/>.
